description: Update an Infoblox service with a merge patch, list edits, or both; at least one is required. The stored object is read first and resent with the changes applied, so fields the patch omits, secrets included, keep their stored values. The remove argument drops elements of the listed arrays by id; the other elements keep their stored values. Right before saving it reads the object again; if another change saved it since the first read, nothing is sent and the call says so: retry the update. Returns the previous object. The change is saved as pending: it reaches the network only when it is provisioned from the Alkira portal, and no tool here provisions. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. Instances are matched by id: keep every stored instance in a patch on instances, or remove one with remove.instances. cxp and an instance's platform cannot change. The backend refuses a changed globalCidrListId once the service has left PENDING, and a changed hostName, or type of a NIOS instance, once that instance is provisioned. Refused with no request while the service is FAILED, SCHEDULED or IN_PROGRESS, or while the network is FAILED and the service was provisioned before. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

id.description: Id of the Infoblox service, as a string of digits such as "123" (not a number). The service_infoblox_get_* read tools and service_infoblox_create return it.

patch.description: RFC 7386 merge patch: fields set here replace the stored values, null removes a field, omitted fields keep their stored values.

billingTags.description: Billing tag ids; billing_tag_get_all lists them. Applies only when the tenant feature BILLING-TAGS is enabled. At most 5 items.

cxp.description: CXP name, for example USEAST-AZURE-1; cxp_get_all lists them. Cannot be changed after create. At most 128 UTF-16 code units. No leading or trailing space.

gridMasterCredentialId.description: Id of a credential stored in the Alkira portal. No tool lists or creates credentials: create the credential in the portal and paste its id here.

sharedSecretCredentialId.description: Id of a credential stored in the Alkira portal. No tool lists or creates credentials: create the credential in the portal and paste its id here.

instances.description: At most 8 items. At least 1 items.

credentialId.description: Id of a credential stored in the Alkira portal. No tool lists or creates credentials: create the credential in the portal and paste its id here.

hostName.description: At most 256 UTF-16 code units. No leading or trailing space.

segments.description: Segment names, not ids; segment_get_all lists them. No leading or trailing space. At most 1 items. At least 1 items.

remove.description: Items to remove from stored lists, per field. Items the stored list does not hold are reported, not refused.

instances.description: Ids of the elements to remove.

name: service_infoblox_update
